sections.label: Context
sections.content: Answering Claude Code's proposal in the same conversation: the shared-paragraph marker opens a panel naming the original and every essay that holds the paragraph, with an explicit divergence button; hover previews for notes and references with keep/deny on the card; and a read-only open-in-new-tab for a note or source before a live companion window (srs-web#426).
